items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: He and I and Monk used to play as strings sometimes.

ctx.x: I'm trying to talk about it now, yeah. I didn't want to put words in your mouth. No, this was Rene. He and I and Monk used to play as strings sometimes. There'd be various people who'd mix in there sometime along the line.

But I was out of the band when Pinky came along. It's hard for me to get the picture of this band at the Miramar in my mind now, today, how they would have sounded with all those different instruments. Now, who carried the lead? I did. You did. Did you play a straight lead or would you call it a hot lead? Swinging, variations?
